Annotation Interface OperationProxy.Proxyable

Enclosing class:
OperationProxy
@Retention(CLASS) @Target(TYPE) public static @interface OperationProxy.Proxyable
Designates a Node class as eligible for proxying.

Execute parameters are ordered as: optional frame when bindFrame() is enabled, BytecodeNode when bindBytecodeNode() is enabled, int when bindBytecodeIndex() is enabled, then evaluated arguments. Enabled bytecode node and index parameters are required on every execute method and are not specialization operands.

Specializations access metadata through @Bind: this metadata comes from execute arguments during AST execution and from current interpreter state during operation execution. Without bindBytecodeIndex, $bytecodeIndex is -1 during AST execution. Binding $bytecodeNode during AST execution without enabling bindBytecodeNode is a generation error.

Since:
24.2

      boolean bindFrame
